title: Finite-node deceleration reconstruction tests coordinate and cutoff assumptions
assumptions: Flat LambdaCDM fiducial with radiation omitted in the displayed late-time q formula; cubic/quartic finite interpolation in z, y or ln(1+z).
Uniform nodes in chosen coordinate; n+1 nodes, n free deviations and endpoint zero at z_c=2.5; uniform node priors [-1,1].
DESI DR2 BAO plus Planck compressed distance summaries and one SN compilation; high-z matching normalization is underspecified, and physical/perturbation closure is absent.
predictions: With E(0)=1, reconstructed E/E_fid is exp[integral delta q/(1+z) dz]; setting delta q zero above cutoff leaves a generally nonunit high-z normalization.
Coordinate/node/order choices and optional SH0ES prior change the fitted q history; reused BAO/CMB combinations are not independent confirmation.
All tabulated log Bayes factors are negative, favoring LambdaCDM under the source priors, despite negative minimum-chi-square differences and authors conditional Wilks significances.
